inspected_existing_sources.finding: ImageLayer owns RGBA8 pixels and current four enum variants are no-ops. New module fits this image owner without replacing source storage.
Existing encoded-sample straight RGBA8 source-over is a compositing operation, not a filter kernel. Filter RGB follows that encoded-sample space and preserves filter-specific alpha contracts.
Existing public CV operator is a fixed 3x3 Gray8 kernel. Its clamped edges and caller-output model are reused, but variable sigma and premultiplied RGBA require a dedicated image-authoring kernel.
Existing RGBA8 buffer handling is detection-overlay drawing and encoding; it has no filter transform or alpha-aware convolution to call.

verification.coverage_staged: Public API known vectors including a width-nine Gaussian impulse outside the clamped edge reach, alpha, clamped edges, tiny images, identities, bounds and preflight atomic errors.

notes: Gaussian coefficients are normalized once into a fixed 97-element stack kernel and reused by both passes. The width-three impulse conservation claim was corrected to width nine, while retaining a separate width-three transparent-edge case. Root owns image.rs module registration and public re-exports.
